description: This file contains React functional components for UI elements such as Loader, ErrorBox, EmptyState, and FormField, exported for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: Loader({ label = "Loading..." })
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator with optional label.

methods.name: ErrorBox({ error })
methods.description: Displays an error message box if an error exists.

methods.name: EmptyState({ title = "No data", subtitle = "Try creating something." })
methods.description: Displays a placeholder UI indicating no data is available.

methods.name: FormField({ label, children, helper })
methods.description: Displays a labeled form field with optional helper text.

ctags.name: EmptyState
ctags.pattern: /^export function EmptyState({ title = "No data", subtitle = "Try creating something." }) {$/
